svg.title: Open subgroups of free abelian topological groups
svg.desc: Proof outline of Theorem 4.3 and Corollary 4.2

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: Open subgroups: Theorem 4.3 at a glance

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif
'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: ρ : A(X) → H continuous homomorphism, H discrete ⟹ ker ρ is a Graev free abelian topological group

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: 1. f := ρ↾X : X → Y = ρ(X) ⟹ ∃! f̃ : A(X) → A(Y) continuous, f̃(X) = Y

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: 2. i : Y ↪ H ⟹ ∃! β : A(Y) → H continuous with ρ = β ∘ f̃

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: 3. Prop. 4.3 (idempotent ε = g̃ ∘ f̃, via Prop. 4.2) ⟹ ker f̃ is Graev free

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: 4. Lemma 4.1 ⟹ ker ρ = ker(β ∘ f̃) ≅ ker f̃ ⊕ D, D discrete free abelian

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: 5. Lemma 4.2 + Cor. 4.1 ⟹ a direct sum of free groups is free

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: ker ρ is a Graev free abelian topological group ∎

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif
'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: K ≤ A(X) open ⟹ K closed ⟹ A(X)/K is discrete ⟹ K = ker(π : A(X) → A(X)/K)

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman','STIX Two Text','Cambria','Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: apply Theorem 4.3 ⟹ K is Graev free
